rationale: P characterises whether required collision-avoidance braking occurs in the declared hazardous situation, which is directly required to evaluate T. SG-1 and FR-7 establish braking behaviour itself as the subject of evaluation. The operational scope matches H-1, whose hazardous event also supports including failure to brake in time. P does not extend to sensing, computation, communication, or failure-management mechanisms merely because they affect braking.
determining_elements: Required braking behaviour, including its presence or absence, directly addresses prevention of omitted braking maneuvers under SG-1 and FR-7.
The straight-ahead, single-lane-road scenario at 50 km/h in good weather, with a pedestrian crossing 20 m ahead, matches H-1's operational situation.

The inclusion of 'failure to brake in time' concerns the collision-avoidance braking behaviour itself and is supported by H-1's failure-to-stop-in-time hazardous event, rather than inferred from observation or processing deadlines.
